answer: What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the comet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the forge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
